HOTEL LOBBY MESSI Lionel Messi has arrived at the hotel, and the lobby is now his concert hall. He walks in bent over, hands on his hips, catching his breath like he just ran the whole way here — because to Messi, even checking in is a workout. Then the music starts and he straightens up. Pink Inter Miami kit, number 10, game face on — and he dances across the fancy carpet. The pointing, the fist pumps, the little shuffle, all in front of the check-in desk, the elevators, the confused guests. And then he starts singing too. Mouth open, belting it out, laughing at his own moves, dancing and singing at the same time like the lobby was built for this concert. The GOAT doesn’t walk into a hotel. He dances in, sings in, and the lobby becomes his stage.
